999008199.text:
あーあ。４対１なんてズルいよねぇ……
しかもヤンネさんまでいるしさぁ

localizations.en: Oh my... Four against one isn't very fair... And with Lady Janne here too...

999008199.text:
さすがにやりすぎよ。それぞれに考えがあるのだから、
もっとよく話し合って――

localizations.en: This has gone too far. Everyone has their own reasons. We should sit down and discuss—

999008199.text:
それ以前の問題よ！　アタシとヤンネさんで
お尻百叩きしてやるから、反省しなさいよね！

localizations.en: That's not even the issue here! Lady Janne and I will spank you a hundred times until you learn your lesson!

999008199.text: あ、ちょっと！　逃げんな！　正座せんかい！

localizations.en: Hey! Don't run away! Get back here and apologize properly!

999008199.text:
ふふ。僕に対してその程度で済ませようなんて、
ちょーっといい子が過ぎるんじゃない？

localizations.en: Hehe. Going so easy on me? You're being a bit TOO nice, don't you think?

999008199.text:
待ちな。何かシトリンの手元が怪しい、
罠があるかも知れない

localizations.en: Hold up. Citrine's up to something. It could be a trap.

999008199.text: まったねぇー、いい子ちゃん！

もっと、ボコボコにすれば良かったってわけ？
ヤンネさんの百叩きを舐めてるわね

localizations.en: So we should've beaten you to a pulp instead? You're underestimating Lady Janne's hundred spankings!

999008199.text: 姉様を愚弄するなんて……許すまじ、なんでも屋

localizations.en: How dare you mock my sister... You'll pay for this!

999008199.text: こらこら。熱くならないの

localizations.en: Now, now. Let's not get too worked up.

999008199.text:
素材は集まったんだろう？
なら、アタシたちも帰ろう

localizations.en: You got all the materials you needed, right? Let's head back then.

999008199.text:
そうだね。あいつがまた何かしでかす前に、
ちゃちゃっと調合しちゃわないと！

localizations.en: Yeah, you're right. Better get started on the synthesis before that troublemaker tries anything else!
